content: ACP session/update carries a monotonically increasing sequenceNumber per session; clients may buffer on gaps and treat out-of-order as agent bug. available_commands_update is a full REPLACEMENT of the command set, not incremental. stdio backpressure: if the client stops reading, the agent's writes block — any goroutine holding the outbound queue can stall the whole turn; a per-session ordered outbound queue is the recommended mitigation.
